title: Tokyo has only two barley tea makers, we visited one to see how mugicha is made
summary: A journalist visits one of only two remaining barley tea (mugicha) manufacturers in Tokyo to document the traditional craft of Japanese barley tea production, highlighting the rarity and cultural significance of this fading industry.
problem_solved: Documents and preserves knowledge about traditional Japanese barley tea making processes before they disappear entirely.
why_valuable: Provides cultural preservation of traditional Japanese food craftsmanship and raises awareness about endangered small-batch food producers in urban Japan.
